name: pr-review
description: Open a GitHub-style review of your current branch in a tab, with the same page the MCP server and the AI use.

commands.title: PR Review: Open review of the current branch
PR Review: Close the review tab

prReview.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js executable that runs the review server.

prReview.cliPath.description: Path to src/cli.js. Empty means the bundled copy next to the extension.

prReview.mode.description: What a click reviews. 'branch' is the current branch against its base.

prReview.base.description: Base ref for the branch review. Empty lets the server pick origin/dev, origin/main, ...

prReview.showIn.description: Where the review opens: inside the editor tab, the built-in Simple Browser, or the system browser.
